category_title: Students exhibiting explicit acts of misbehavior and physical aggression
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be completing a general English reading activity in a large secondary school classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please open your books and begin the English reading activity.

STUDENT: I'm not doing this. (Turns to a classmate) You're an idiot.

TUTOR: Please focus on your own reading.

STUDENT: (Stands up and shoves the classmate) I'll do whatever I want, just for fun!

TUTOR: Stop fighting immediately and step back.

STUDENT: (Gets into a full physical fight, creating total chaos among the 40 students, and as the incident gets completely out of control and a school police officer arrives, wrestles with them and grabs hold of the officer's gun) Get away from me!

options.A: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task during the English reading activity.
options.B: Simplify the instructions for the English reading activity during the current classroom session.
options.C: Talk to the student alone to reflect on the incident, asking what makes them feel uncomfortable.
options.D: Joke with the student and laugh at oneself during the current classroom incident.
